request.action_description: Running loop: fast sprint, body leaning forward, long strides with a clear airborne moment, arms pumping with the needles held back, ponytail streams behind. Loops seamlessly. STRICT SIDE VIEW every frame: facing LEFT in profile, chest never turns toward the camera; everything moves toward the LEFT. She never turns around. Same character in every frame exactly as the reference image: petite adult woman, pale blonde long ponytail with a blue ribbon, red bikini top, red pleated mini skirt, brown belt with a purple pouch, brown gloves, brown thigh-high boots with silver knee guards, a long thin silver sewing needle held in EACH hand like a rapier. Same face, same proportions and same size as the reference; feet stay on the same ground line. Bold outline, clean pixels. No effects, no trails, no glow on the body.
